rule.title: Line 16 bond premium is a carryforward or premium on a bond acquired before October 23, 1986

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this amortizable bond premium NOT one line 16 takes — that is, not a bond premium carryforward and not on a bond acquired before October 23, 1986 (premium on a later bond offsets the bond's interest instead)?

citation.wording: A deduction for amortizable bond premium (for example, a deduction allowed for a bond premium carryforward or a deduction for amortizable bond premium on bonds acquired before October 23, 1986).
